description: Extended eval set covering QA(refusal included), PLANNING(diverse), META queries

cases.text: What is the host range of cucumber mosaic virus?
cases.notes: CMV is well-documented in ICTV and literature

cases.text: How does rice stripe virus overwinter in temperate regions?
cases.notes: RSV overwintering should be in literature

cases.text: Compare the economic losses caused by potato virus Y in China versus Peru from 2018 to 2023
cases.notes: Specific economic comparison unlikely in corpus
